summary: Flat kerb at the top of the street, cars park, homes 12-15 m away.
reasons: Dwellings 12-15 m away on same side

best_section.where: East kerb at the northern bend, just before the main road junction

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 12-15 m away on the east side and 15-20 m across the road; tree cover helps.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along the east kerb, so room to stop.
drivers.traffic: Quiet street end, with the arterial road about 25 m north.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb; No Parking 9am-5pm weekdays and No Stopping signs close by.

flags: Dwellings 10-25 m away on both sides
No Parking 9am-5pm Mon-Fri and No Stopping Any Time signs nearby
Arterial road noise from the north
sun_shade: Trees shade the east kerb from the east and south; open to the afternoon sun.
